definitions.gloss: gaping; open-mouthed; with mouth wide open in surprise or shock
definitions.explanation: Describes the state of having one's mouth open wide, typically from shock, surprise, or disbelief. A vivid mimetic expression.

examples.japanese: あんぐり⟦{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける→口を開ける：23832_kuchiwoakeru⟧。
⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧あんぐり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was left gaping when I saw the amount on the bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{突拍子|とっぴょうし}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あんぐり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone gaped open-mouthed at his outrageous remark.

notes:
A mimetic word that vividly evokes the image of a mouth hanging open in shock. Often used with ⟦{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける→口を開ける：23832_kuchiwoakeru⟧ (to open one's mouth) or simply as あんぐり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あんぐり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to gape, to be left open-mouthed
- あんぐり⟦{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける→口を開ける：23832_kuchiwoakeru⟧: to gape with mouth wide open
- あんぐり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: gaped open-mouthed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぽかん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: blankly — mouth open from being dazed or spacing out; less shock
- ⟦{唖然|あぜん}→唖然：09404_azen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: speechless — formal word for being struck dumb with shock
- ⟦{開|あ}いた→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がらない→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧: jaw-dropping (idiom) — so shocked one can't close one's mouth
- ⟦びっくり→びっくり：03003_bikkuri⟧: surprised — general surprise; not specifically about the mouth
